description: Canaux et autres ouvrages de transport pour l'irrigation dans le Haut-Rhin is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geostandards.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Positioning of canals and other collective water transport works for irrigation. These are the structuring channels for irrigation. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Canals and other transport works for irrigation in the Upper Rhine" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include transport d'eau, ouvrage collectif, canaux, données ouvertes, irrigation. The listing shows 2018-02-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
